requirement.anchorMapField: No direct AnchorMap term found; propose code-safe alias: food-waste discharge and distance/ice-concentration properties
requirement.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF operating_area = Arctic_waters AND food_waste_discharge_to_sea = true, THEN distance_to_nearest_land_ice_shelf_or_fast_ice_nm >= 12 and the distance from areas with ice_concentration_tenths > 1 shall be recorded.
requirement.requiredInputs: Discharge record, position, nearest-feature distances, and ice data
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: Discharge into the sea of food wastes is only permitted when the ship is as far as practicable from areas of ice concentration exceeding 1/10, but in any case not less than 12 nautical miles from the nearest land, nearest ice-shelf, or nearest fast ice.
